chunks: I passed by Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) while he had lodged at al-Hira. He said to me: 'What is your occupation?' I said: 'Animal trader.' So he said: 'Find a fazaa mule for me.' I said: 'May I be sacrificed for you! And what is al-fazaa?' He said: 'Dark, with a white belly, white thighs, and a white mouth.' He said: So I said: 'By Allah! I have not seen the likes of this description.'

So I returned from his presence, and after a while I entered the ditch (market), and suddenly there was a slave who had been riding a mule of this very description. So I asked the slave: 'Whose mule is this?' He said: 'My master's.' I said: 'Will he sell it?' He said: 'I do not know.' So I followed him until I came to his master and I bought it from him, and I came to him (the Imam) with it. So he said: 'This is the description I wanted.'

I said: 'May I be sacrificed for you! Supplicate to Allah for me.' So he said: 'May Allah amplify your wealth and your children.' He said: So I became the most abundant of the people of al-Kufa in wealth and children.

key_terms.جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ: A devotional formula of respect: 'May I be sacrificed for you' — used by companions addressing the Imams
key_terms.دَهْمَاءُ: Dark/bay in color — describing the dominant dark coat of the mule
key_terms.عِلَاجُكَ: Your trade/occupation — a colloquial Classical Arabic term for one's profession or livelihood
key_terms.فَضْحَاءُ: Fazaa — a specific type of mule, dark (bay) in body but with distinctively white belly, inner legs, and lips

ai.seo_question: What story does al-Kafi contain about Imam al-Sadiq and a mule trader from al-Hira?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates how Tarkhan al-Nakhkhas, an animal trader, encountered Imam al-Sadiq (AS) at al-Hira. The Imam requested a very specifically described mule — dark-colored with white belly, white inner thighs, and white lips — a description considered rare. After miraculously finding exactly such an animal in the marketplace, the narrator brought it to the Imam who confirmed it matched. As a reward for his service, Imam al-Sadiq supplicated for his wealth and children to be increased, and the narrator reports that this blessing was fulfilled, making him among the most wealthy and blessed with children in Kufa.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Tarkhan Al Nakhas who said, ‘I passed by Abu Abdullahasws and heasws had lodged at Al-Hira, so heasws said to me: ‘What is your occupation?’ I said, ‘Animal trader’. So heasws said: ‘Find a Fazaah mule for me’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! And what is Al-Fazaah?’ Heasws said: ‘Plain, of white belly, white thighs, white mouth’. I said, ‘By Allahazwj! I have not seen the likes of this description’.

So I returned from his<sup>asws</sup> presence, so after a while I entered the ditch, and there was a slave who had sat upon a mule of this description. So I asked the slave, ‘For whom is this mule?’ So he said, ‘For my master’. I said, ‘Would he sell it’. He said, ‘I do not know’. So I followed him until I came up to his master. So I bought it from him, and I came over with it to him<sup>asws</sup>(the Imam<sup>asws</sup>). So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is the description which I<sup>asws</sup> wanted’.

I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! Supplicate to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for me’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Amplify your wealth and your children’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So I became to be of the most abundant of the people of Al-Kufa in wealth and children’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Tarkhan al-Nakhkhas who has said the following: “I once visited abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when he had disembarked in al-Hirah and asked me, ‘What do you do for a living?’ I replied, ‘I trade in animals.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Find for me a mule which is Fadha ’.’ I then asked saying, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, what is Fadha’?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is of one color except for its white belly, white thighs of the back legs and of white harness area.’ He (the narrator) has said, ‘I said, by Allah I have not seen any mule as such.’

After (a while), I entered the ditch and saw a slave riding a mule of such description. I asked, ‘Whose mule is this?’ The slave said that it belongs to his master. I then asked, ‘Does he sell it?’ He said, ‘I do not know.’ I went to his master, bought it from him, and brought it to him (the Imam). He (the Imam) said, ‘This mule is of the qualities that I had asked for.’

I then said, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, pray for me before Allah.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘O Allah, grant him a great deal of assets and children.’ He (the narrator) has said, ‘I then became the wealthiest of the people of al-Kufah as well in terms of children.’”
